fields.description: Init sentinel: first u32 of the RAM save struct. FUN_08000ca4 compares it against the expected value and, on mismatch, zeroes 0xDC bytes and rewrites it before calling FUN_08000d80. Baseline logical bytes are EF BE 00 00 = 0x0000BEEF.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000ca4 compares *piVar1 (buffer word 0) to the expected sentinel and rewrites it on mismatch; FUN_08000d30 loads it via FUN_08073614 EEPROM address 0 into RAM offset 0; FUN_08000d80 stores it via FUN_080736c4. Baseline logical offset 0 reads 0xBEEF.
fields.name: save_init_sentinel

fields.description: Spare word: second u32 of EEPROM address-0 block. Transferred verbatim by the FUN_08000d30 load loop (address 0, RAM/save offset 4) and the FUN_08000d80 store loop; zero in the fresh-init baseline. Per-word role unresolved from code-only decomp.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000d30 loops 0x1b EEPROM addresses with +8 stride via FUN_08073614 into RAM/save offsets addr*8; FUN_08000d80 mirrors it via FUN_080736c4 with FUN_080737a0 verify. Offset 4 is the tail of address-0 block.
fields.name: block00_spare

fields.description: First word of the EEPROM address-1 block (start of the gameplay data area at save offset 8). Round-trips through FUN_08000d30/FUN_08000d80 block loops; zero in the fresh-init baseline. Exposed as a scalar so live mutation testing can probe it.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000d30 reads EEPROM address 1 via FUN_08073614 into RAM/save offsets 8..15; FUN_08000d80 writes it back via FUN_080736c4 (address 1) and verifies via FUN_080737a0.
fields.name: blocks01_08_first_word

fields.description: Remaining 60 bytes of EEPROM address blocks 1..8 (save offsets 12..71). Bulk gameplay data region transferred by the FUN_08000d30 (+8 stride, 0x1b iterations) and FUN_08000d80 loops; all zero in the fresh-init baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000d30 loads EEPROM addresses 1..8 via FUN_08073614 into RAM/save offsets 8..71; FUN_08000d80 stores them via FUN_080736c4 with FUN_080737a0 read-back verify.
fields.name: blocks01_08_rest

fields.description: First word of the EEPROM address-9 block (save offset 72). Round-trips through FUN_08000d30/FUN_08000d80 block loops; zero in the fresh-init baseline. Exposed as a scalar so live mutation testing can probe it.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000d30 reads EEPROM address 9 via FUN_08073614 into RAM/save offsets 72..79; FUN_08000d80 writes it back via FUN_080736c4 (address 9) and verifies via FUN_080737a0.
fields.name: blocks09_16_first_word

fields.description: Remaining 60 bytes of EEPROM address blocks 9..16 (save offsets 76..135). Bulk gameplay data region transferred by the FUN_08000d30 and FUN_08000d80 loops; all zero in the fresh-init baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000d30 loads EEPROM addresses 9..16 via FUN_08073614 into RAM/save offsets 72..135; FUN_08000d80 stores them via FUN_080736c4 with FUN_080737a0 read-back verify.
fields.name: blocks09_16_rest

fields.description: Full 64 bytes of EEPROM address blocks 17..24 (save offsets 136..199). Bulk gameplay data region transferred by the FUN_08000d30 and FUN_08000d80 loops; all zero in the fresh-init baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000d30 loads EEPROM addresses 17..24 via FUN_08073614 into RAM/save offsets 136..199; FUN_08000d80 stores them via FUN_080736c4 with FUN_080737a0 read-back verify.
fields.name: blocks17_24

fields.description: Full 16 bytes of EEPROM address blocks 25..26 (save offsets 200..215), the last written blocks. FUN_08000d30/FUN_08000d80 loop bound is 0x1b (27 addresses: 0..26), so offsets 216+ are never written and read back as erased 0xFF.
fields.evidence: FUN_08000d30 and FUN_08000d80 iterate addresses while index < 0x1b with +8 stride, covering save offsets 200..215 via FUN_08073614/FUN_080736c4; baseline offsets 216..511 are erased 0xFF, proving nothing is stored there.
fields.name: blocks25_26

magic_signatures.description: Init sentinel 0xBEEF at logical offset 0 (little-endian EF BE); rewritten by FUN_08000ca4 whenever the save is uninitialized.
